# ffmpeg-vertical-video

> Tested FFmpeg commands for vertical (9:16) short video for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and Facebook Reels: 30
> commands in 15 recipes, each run in CI on generated clips and checked with ffprobe and the decoded pixels. Also an agent skill. MIT.

Short answers:
- 16:9 to 9:16 by cropping the middle: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf "crop=ih*9/16:ih,scale=1080:1920,setsar=1" -c:v libx264 -crf 20 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy vertical.mp4
- One file built to all four apps' upload specs: H.264 High profile, yuv420p, progressive, 30 fps, a 2 s closed GOP, a capped bitrate, AAC 48 kHz stereo, -movflags +faststart, -use_editlist 0 (see Export settings). It keeps the source's length.

## Recipes

- [Convert a 16:9 video to 9:16 with FFmpeg](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video/blob/main/recipes/16x9-to-9x16.md): turn a horizontal video into a vertical one
- [FFmpeg export settings for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Facebook Reels](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video/blob/main/recipes/export-settings.md): export one file for every app
- [Compress a video to a target file size with FFmpeg](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video/blob/main/recipes/compress-to-size.md): compress to a file size
- [Trim or cut a video with FFmpeg](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video/blob/main/recipes/trim.md): cut a clip or trim to a length
- [Speed up or slow down a video with FFmpeg](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video/blob/main/recipes/speed.md): change the speed
- [Loop a video to a set length with FFmpeg](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video/blob/main/recipes/loop.md): loop a clip
- [Burn captions and text into a vertical video with FFmpeg](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video/blob/main/recipes/captions.md): burn captions or a title into the picture
- [Normalize audio loudness to a LUFS target with FFmpeg](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video/blob/main/recipes/loudness.md): set the loudness (lufs)
- [Add background music to a video with FFmpeg](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video/blob/main/recipes/music.md): add music under a voice, or remove the sound
- [Extract a cover frame or thumbnail from a video with FFmpeg](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video/blob/main/recipes/cover-frame.md): save a frame as a cover image
- [Make a video from an image and audio with FFmpeg](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video/blob/main/recipes/still-image-video.md): turn a picture and a sound into a video
- [Stack two videos into a vertical split screen with FFmpeg](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video/blob/main/recipes/split-screen.md): stack two videos, top and bottom
- [Rotate a sideways video with FFmpeg](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video/blob/main/recipes/rotate.md): rotate a sideways video
- [Join video clips into one with FFmpeg](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video/blob/main/recipes/join-clips.md): join clips end to end
- [Convert an HDR iPhone video to SDR with FFmpeg](https://github.com/viewgum/ffmpeg-vertical-video/blob/main/recipes/hdr-to-sdr.md): convert hdr to sdr
